text: This Motion submits a report with Confidential Attachment with respect to an urgent matter pertaining to the redevelopment of St. Lawrence Market North. The City Manager and City Solicitor have prepared an urgent report to City Council to provide a confidential update to City Council on certain matters respecting St. Lawrence Market North. This update is confidential as it contains advice or communications that concern the security of the property of the City and are subject to solicitor-client privilege. This update is time-sensitive and must be considered before the next regular meeting of City Council in order to meet deadlines pertaining to legal and/or contractual matters.

City Council on May 22, 23 and 24, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 23, 2018) from the City Manager and the City Solicitor remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege. Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 23, 2018) from the City Manager and the City Solicitor remains confidential in its entirety in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
